Name: Sandwich
Author: LeFauxMatt
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ulr2XSt.png[/img]
To make sandwiches, first you must purchase the Sandwich Prep Table from the Saloon (or you can use a mod like CJB Item Spawner to cheat one in). Once you have it, all you need to do is place a bread, followed by toppings (all edible items are accepted), and finally top  it off with another bread.

When eaten, sandwiches give you the effects of all the toppings.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oszWv38.png[/img]
If sandwich is uninstalled, then Sandwiches and the Sandwich Prep Table will convert into Error Items.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lG4kcA2.png[/img]
This mod currently does not have any config options.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fMhu2q8.png[/img]
See [url=https://github.com/LeFauxMatt/Sandwich/#translations]here[/url] for the current status on translations.
